title: Take-up Rate of SkillsFuture-supported AI-related Training Course
what_it_is: Take-up Rate of SkillsFuture-supported AI-related Training Course

sections.label: AI training and upskilling support
sections.summary: The Government encourages Singaporeans to pursue AI upskilling and supports them with course fee subsidies and SkillsFuture Credit, though AI courses still cost hundreds to thousands of dollars.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: While we do not set targets specifically on the number of workers who go for AI training, we encourage all Singaporeans to pursue upskilling and lifelong learning to stay relevant, including by keeping abreast of AI and other developments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to support Singaporeans in their upskilling journey through substantial course fee subsidies as well as the SkillsFuture Credit to offset out-of-pocket costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
sentences.text: The 1,600 or so AI courses listed do cost a few hundred dollars to a few thousand dollars, even after funding.

sections.label: Reviewing AI course signposting and tracking
sections.summary: The Government will review course signposting and curation, work with industry to map tasks to courses, and track how trained individuals are deployed, though not specifically for AI.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The short answer to all three is that we will continue to review how we signpost, direct and curate courses, and encourage Singaporeans to take up these courses to be able to support their lifelong learning and make every opportunity that they are aspiring to available to them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are working with the industry to look to see how we develop the list of tasks and map them to the courses – to address his first point.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are trying to improve our signposting, both in terms of the websites, the online offerings as well as the counselling that people get, so that there is a sense of where the journey should take them as they develop their AI skills.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Does the Government plan to track the deployment of individuals and workers at the workplace after their attendance of such AI courses, in view of the significant public subsidies that the Government expenses on these courses?

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Certainly, we work closely with the economic agencies and the industry to understand how individuals who go through training then subsequently are deployed and use their skills.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The overall approach is there, but to say that we do so specifically for AI, may be a little bit harder.
